# GSAP 3.15.1 (local copy)

From npm `gsap@3.15.1`, `dist/*.min.js`. Free under GreenSock's standard license (https://gsap.com/standard-license).

```html
<script src="/js/vendor/gsap/gsap.min.js"></script>
<script src="/js/vendor/gsap/ScrollTrigger.min.js"></script>
<script>gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);</script>
```
Plugins: ScrollTrigger, ScrollToPlugin, Flip, Draggable, InertiaPlugin, Observer, SplitText, TextPlugin, MotionPathPlugin, DrawSVGPlugin, MorphSVGPlugin, CustomEase, EasePack. Load gsap.min.js first. Pages in `materials/` use a relative path (e.g. `../../js/vendor/gsap/...`).
